sentences.text: 1 The bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court on 17.08.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Lalit Prakash, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Suchit Tandon, learned AGA from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1.
Learned counsel for the applicant contests the minority of the victim as depicted in the prosecution case.

2. The victim was wrongly shown as a minor of 15 years 4 months and 8 days of age in the F.I.R. only to falsely implicate the applicant under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the age of the victim set out in the prosecution case in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.

entities.text:
Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) The victim in her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has asserted that she is 14 years of age.
(iii) Medico-legal examination (not the age determination test) records that the victim is 14 years of age.

(iv) No medical examination to determine the correct age of the victim as per the latest scientific criteria and medical protocol by eminent doctors from a reputed institution was got done by the prosecution as it would establish the majority of the victim and falsify the prosecution case.
The victim is in fact a major.
4. The victim was intimate with the principal offender Rahul and she eloped with him.
5. The FIR was lodged only to deflect attention from the conduct of the victim.
6. The incident occurred on 09.05.2023.
The FIR was got lodged by the brother of the deceased on 17.05.2023 at 18.20 hrs.
7. Delay in lodgement of the FIR in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
8. The applicant was not named in the FIR.

sentences.text: 9. Subsequently, false and aggravated allegations were made by the victim in her statements under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. to save the failing prosecution case.
10. Material contradictions in the FIR, the statement of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. discredit the prosecution case.
11. The victim was never confined or bound down in any manner.
The victim was present at various public places but never raised an alarm nor did she resist the applicant.
The conduct of the victim shows that she was a consenting party.
12. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
13. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
14. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of her influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Harendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
The applicant has applied for recruitment in the police constabulary examination.
The examination shall be conducted on 18.02.2024.
A copy of this order shall be sent forthwith by the Registry to the trial court so that the release of the applicant can be processed as per the law expeditiously and in any case before 18.02.2024.

The trial court and all other authorities including jail authorities shall ensure that all steps are taken for release of applicant before 18.02.2024 if he moves an application for being set forth at liberty in pursuance of the orders passed by this Court.
